name: Hazy Memories by Julia Nimke
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
The Hazy Memories recipe is a great addition to the Sunkissed Warmth recipe, tailored for cloudy conditions. It adds warmth and reduces the clean digital look, bringing an emotional, old-school vibe to your photos. Ideal for flat, cloudy lighting conditions, this recipe also goes well with capturing urban cityscapes and architecture, especially when there’s a sense of shadow play within the frame.
